name: Camping
summary: Build a campfire, then party members place profession-made camp objects around it. Sit within range for a minute to get all their buffs, crafting stations, vendors and Rested XP. Higher-tier campfires hold more objects.
steps: Learn Cooking (needed to make the campfire)
Gather Flint and Tinder plus Simple Wood (Basic), Star Wood (Journeyman, skill 140) or Thick Logs (Expert, skill 220)
Craft and place the campfire: it burns about 10 minutes, with a 5-minute cooldown
Each character places one camp object (1-hour cooldown)
/sit inside the radius for a minute to get the buffs
tips: Camp buffs are slightly weaker than class buffs and don't stack with them, but replace them
Rest again to add new objects' effects without losing old ones
Hover the Camp Benefits buff to see what you have
Cozy Sleeping Bag and food XP bonus stack with camp buffs
Legacy talents: Field Guide (shorter cooldown), Permanence (longer buffs), Reagent Economy (free basic objects)

name: Library Books
summary: Books scattered around the world that you hand to a librarian for jewellery and other rewards at 10, 20 and 25 books.
steps: Turn them in to Garon Wendell (Stormwind) or Owen Thadd (Undercity)
10 books: Scholarly Pendant or Erudite's Amulet
20 books (level 20): Field Researcher's Loop or Philanthropist's Ring
25 books (level 30): Truthseeker's Bow, Crest of Elucidation or Researcher's Night Light

name: Transmog & outfits
summary: Change how your gear looks using appearances you've collected, account-wide. You can only transmog to the same armour type. Two Outfit slots are free; more cost 1g up to 100g.
steps: Visit a Transmogrifier: Fyrenz Vishonar (Stormwind Mage District 48, 84), Mon'ye (Orgrimmar Cleft of Shadows 46, 54) or Spellweaver Thaldris (Dalaran 18, 61, Alliance)
Unlock looks from quest rewards, gear you collect (BoE needs binding or selling) and group loot rolls
Apply looks per slot, same armour type
Save Outfits and swap freely out of combat
Optionally switch outfits automatically by zone, spec, weather or time of day
tips: A quest reward unlocks every reward option's appearance
Being present for a group loot roll unlocks it even if you lose
Transmog stays on the slot when you equip an upgrade
Turn transmog off for free to see real gear
